how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-duskwood-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5:details:0: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds! I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.
rows.quest:5:details:1: BBring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.
rows.quest:5:details:2: BI heard Chef Grual at the ⟦E1⟧ Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
rows.quest:5:completion:0: You need some Crab Cakes, do you? Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
rows.quest:55:obj:0: Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to ⟦E2⟧ at his camp.
rows.quest:55:details:0: Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery. His time in this land is drawing to an end...
rows.quest:55:details:1: BUse Morbent's Bane against him. It will render his protective magics powerless.
rows.quest:55:details:2: BSlay him. Slay him, and save us from his wickedness. Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:55:completion:0: Morbent Fel has been defeated. The dark riders are still at large, but a small piece of that which I had hoped beyond hope has come to pass.
rows.quest:55:completion:1: BYou have done the impossible, and your deeds will forever live in the legends of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:55:completion:2: BGo, ⟦1⟧. And perhaps, one day, fate may bring you back to me...
rows.quest:56:obj:0: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.
rows.quest:56:details:0: As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire. ⟦E4⟧ has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.
rows.quest:56:details:1: BIf you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages. The undead threat must be thwarted!
rows.quest:56:completion:0: Splendid, ⟦2⟧. For your service to the people of Darkshire you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:57:obj:0: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.
rows.quest:57:details:0: ⟦3⟧, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest! If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors. There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. The undead must be driven from ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:57:completion:0: The people of Darkshire thank you, ⟦4⟧. You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
rows.quest:58:obj:0: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 20 Plague Spreaders in the eastern Raven Hill mausoleum.
rows.quest:58:details:0: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim. The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, ⟦5⟧. I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe. We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!
rows.quest:58:completion:0: On behalf of the people of Darkshire and as the Leader of the Night Watch, I thank you, ⟦6⟧, for your bravery and dedication. May the Light shine upon your ways.
rows.quest:66:obj:0: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
rows.quest:66:details:0: Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins. I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger. I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.
rows.quest:66:details:1: BAfter taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery. A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.
rows.quest:66:details:2: BSeek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character. I fear for us all.
rows.quest:66:completion:0: Ah so Madame Eva sent you....
rows.quest:67:obj:0: ⟦E5⟧ to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.
rows.quest:67:details:0: Stalvan, eh? Let me check the town registry.
rows.quest:67:details:1: BStalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see. Ah, here we go! I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle. The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse. My, talk about outdated!
rows.quest:67:details:2: BDo me a favor will you, friend? If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow. I like to keep the records clean.
rows.quest:68:obj:0: Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.
rows.quest:68:details:0: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
rows.quest:68:completion:0: Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.
rows.quest:69:obj:0: Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.
rows.quest:69:details:0: Oh my! Must have missed this the first time. In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out. Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire. Might want to check there, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:70:obj:0: Retrieve Stalvan's Undelivered Letter from the chest and deliver it to the Canal District in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:70:details:0: The name Stalvan rings a bell. I remember now.
rows.quest:70:details:1: BMany years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night. Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear. Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.
rows.quest:70:details:2: BIn his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs. He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in ⟦E4⟧. Help yourself to it.
rows.quest:70:completion:0: You've got some nerve bringing this here.
rows.quest:72:obj:0: Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.
rows.quest:72:details:0: My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was. He had to mop the blood up after the massacre. But that's neither here nor there.
rows.quest:72:details:1: BThe last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up. Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction. Blame the tax vultures. I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk. Who knows what you might find.
rows.quest:72:completion:0: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off. . . .
rows.quest:74:obj:0: The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
rows.quest:74:details:0: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books. Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.
rows.quest:74:completion:0: I can barely make out those letters. But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.
rows.quest:75:obj:0: Marshal Haggard wants you to check the chest upstairs for the Faded Journal Page.
rows.quest:75:details:0: There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place. I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers.
rows.quest:75:details:1: BDo an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character. I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you. Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.
rows.quest:78:obj:0: Take the Faded Journal Page to Tavernkeep Smitts.
rows.quest:78:details:0: I know of someone who might be able to assist you. Back when I was leading the ⟦E4⟧ Guard, we used to get drinks at the ⟦E1⟧ Raven Tavern in Darkshire. The ⟦E6⟧ there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore. Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.
rows.quest:78:completion:0: By the Light! You bet I recognize that handwriting.
rows.quest:79:obj:0: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
rows.quest:79:details:0: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years. When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate. I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods. Your trail of evidence proves his guilt. Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
rows.quest:79:completion:0: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:80:obj:0: Show Clerk Daltry the Bloodstained Journal Page.
rows.quest:80:details:0: I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime. But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.
rows.quest:80:details:1: BIn all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting. Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.
rows.quest:80:completion:0: Why yes! The writing on this page does in fact match that of the registry signatures.
rows.quest:90:obj:0: Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and ⟦E4⟧ Seasoning Herbs and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
rows.quest:90:details:0: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite! Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks as well as some ⟦E4⟧ Seasoning Herbs. There are so many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem. For the herbs, seek out Felicia Gump in her canal district flower shop in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:90:completion:0: Very nice work, ⟦9⟧! Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
rows.quest:93:obj:0: Gather 6 Gooey Spider Legs and bring them to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
rows.quest:93:details:0: I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs! I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks! Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.
rows.quest:93:details:1: BI hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
rows.quest:93:completion:0: Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there! Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...
rows.quest:93:completion:1: BAnd, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
rows.quest:95:obj:0: Go to ⟦E2⟧'s Farm and find what was buried behind the old stump.
rows.quest:95:details:0: I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from ⟦E7⟧ descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!
rows.quest:95:details:1: BWhen I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something. He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders. So I never discovered what was hidden.
rows.quest:95:details:2: BIf you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful. The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
rows.quest:95:completion:0: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.
rows.quest:97:obj:0: Report the news to Commander Ebonlocke.
rows.quest:97:details:0: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, ⟦10⟧! Her suspicions were correct!
rows.quest:98:obj:0: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
rows.quest:98:details:0: Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity. Innocent victims died by his hand. Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes. Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire. The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting. ⟦E5⟧ to his cottage just north of town, ⟦12⟧, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.
rows.quest:98:details:1: BWhen the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring. After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery. But Darkshire is safer because of her.
rows.quest:98:completion:0: I know, ⟦13⟧: Stalvan is dead. I sensed a wave of hope ripple through the tainted forest. Once and for all, ⟦E3⟧ is free from his blood thirst. My joy is hampered by thoughts of those who fell prey to the horrible beast. Nonetheless, you are a brave and cunning ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:101:obj:0: Bring 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
rows.quest:101:details:0: As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, ⟦15⟧. The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.
rows.quest:101:details:1: BIf you wish to protect yourself, noble ⟦16⟧, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom. For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
rows.quest:101:completion:0: Very wise of you, ⟦17⟧. This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout ⟦E8⟧ and beyond. When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura. Be brave, fair ⟦18⟧. You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
rows.quest:133:obj:0: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
rows.quest:133:details:0: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me! In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!
rows.quest:133:details:1: BI want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls. To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs. You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.
rows.quest:133:details:2: BGet the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
rows.quest:133:completion:0: Ah, thanks. These will do just the trick!
rows.quest:134:details:0: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me! I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.
rows.quest:134:details:1: BAfter they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern ⟦E3⟧. I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.
rows.quest:134:details:2: BPlease, ⟦19⟧, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
rows.quest:134:completion:0: Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, ⟦20⟧! You have more than earned your reward.
rows.quest:148:details:0: Oh, what is a poor old man to do? I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.
rows.quest:148:details:1: BCan you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread? You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
rows.quest:148:completion:0: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it? I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
rows.quest:149:obj:0: Bring the Spectral Comb to ⟦E9⟧ Mary.
rows.quest:149:details:0: There is a poor, sad spirit, ⟦E9⟧ Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.
rows.quest:149:details:1: BHere, take this Spectral Comb and ask ⟦E9⟧ Mary to comb her hair. Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.
rows.quest:149:details:2: BAnd take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
rows.quest:149:completion:0: What is this? A comb? It's lovely! And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is.
rows.quest:149:completion:1: BOh, if only I had a mirror...
rows.quest:154:obj:0: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
rows.quest:154:details:1: BTake it, take this comb away from me!
rows.quest:154:details:2: BI'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!
rows.quest:154:completion:0: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare. Here are some coins for those extra strands.
rows.quest:156:obj:0: Gather 8 Rot Blossoms and bring them to Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire.
rows.quest:156:details:0: If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.
rows.quest:156:details:1: BRot blossoms grow in strange places. In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!
rows.quest:156:details:2: BThe Raven Hill Cemetery is lousy with those skeletons. You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms. The town of Darkshire would be grateful.
rows.quest:156:completion:0: Good, you got the rot blossoms. And I'll tell Althea Ebonlocke of the Night Watch that you were killing skeletons.
rows.quest:156:completion:1: BKeeping the people of Darkshire safe is a grim burden for the Night Watch, and news that others are helping stem the tide of fiends in ⟦E3⟧ is welcome news indeed.
rows.quest:157:obj:0: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.
rows.quest:157:details:0: Here is your thread, ⟦21⟧. It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
rows.quest:157:completion:1: BHere, good ⟦22⟧, take this as payment for your honorable deed.
rows.quest:158:details:0: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice. Tavernkeep Smitts at the ⟦E1⟧ Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.
rows.quest:158:details:1: BAnd please hurry, ⟦23⟧. These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
rows.quest:158:completion:0: You need some Zombie Juice, do you? Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
rows.quest:159:obj:0: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.
rows.quest:159:details:1: B...and be careful with this stuff. It's strong enough to raise the dead!
rows.quest:159:completion:0: A thousand thanks, ⟦24⟧. You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!
rows.quest:159:completion:1: BHere you are, friend. Take this as a token of my gratitude.
rows.quest:160:obj:0: Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
rows.quest:160:details:0: Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.
rows.quest:160:details:1: BHe and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am! Hahahaha!
rows.quest:160:completion:1: BWhat language is this? It looks ancient...I can't read it.
rows.quest:163:obj:0: Find out what is haunting Raven Hill.
rows.quest:163:details:0: Something's amiss at Raven Hill, ⟦26⟧. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.
rows.quest:163:details:1: BIf, as you say, you care about the safety of ⟦E3⟧, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
rows.quest:163:completion:0: No! Please don't kill me! It's just me... ⟦E10⟧!! They're everywhere... I can't escape them! Monsters in Raven Hill? N-n-n-o... couldn't be. Only harmless ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:164:details:0: Do you know ⟦E2⟧? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:164:details:1: BUnfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
rows.quest:164:completion:0: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
rows.quest:165:obj:0: Check on the old man in the shack near Raven Hill cemetery.
rows.quest:165:details:0: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
rows.quest:165:completion:0: Hehe, oh yes... of course, the Carevins.
rows.quest:165:completion:1: BNo, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?
rows.quest:173:obj:0: Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
rows.quest:173:details:0: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to ⟦E3⟧. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.
rows.quest:173:details:1: BYou believe yourself worthy to join us?
rows.quest:173:details:2: BI once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.
rows.quest:173:details:3: BTest your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
rows.quest:173:completion:0: Impressive, ⟦27⟧. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.
rows.quest:173:completion:1: BIt is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
rows.quest:174:obj:0: Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire wants you to bring him a bronze tube.
rows.quest:174:details:0: My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars. A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.
rows.quest:174:details:1: BBring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer. That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
rows.quest:174:completion:0: This is perfect, ⟦28⟧. The first step is complete!
rows.quest:175:obj:0: Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
rows.quest:175:details:0: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light. I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass. Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project? I believe she once resided in southern ⟦E3⟧. . .
rows.quest:175:completion:0: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.
rows.quest:177:obj:0: Retrieve ⟦E9⟧ Mary's Looking Glass from the Insane Ghoul and give it to Viktori in Darkshire.
rows.quest:177:details:0: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident. After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn. There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there. Perhaps he picked it up. Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
rows.quest:177:completion:0: Most superb! This will work perfectly. Many thanks!
rows.quest:181:obj:0: Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in ⟦E3⟧ and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
rows.quest:181:details:0: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device. Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort. The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.
rows.quest:181:details:1: BThere is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern ⟦E3⟧. If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
rows.quest:181:completion:0: At last! The stargazing device is complete! Thank you, ⟦29⟧. Now I can continue my research. . .
